picks.name: Solely® Organic Mango & Raspberry Fruit Gummies

Nut-free snacks for a school party.summary: Two nut-free party snacks passed the check: SkinnyPop Avocado Lime popcorn and Solely Organic Mango & Raspberry fruit gummies. Both are declared free from peanuts and tree nuts by Kroger with no conflicting sources. Always read the package label on the day, since a shared-facility warning can change between production runs.

picks.name: Saffron Road® Butter Chicken Gluten-Free Indian Frozen Meal

picks.name: Lean Cuisine Four Cheese Pizza Frozen Meal
picks.why: Also GLP-1 friendly with score 5. 390 kcal, 20 g protein, 3 g fiber, 3 g added sugars. Not a fit if you avoid wheat, milk, or soy, since it contains all three.

GLP-1 friendly frozen lunches.summary: Two frozen meals in the catalog score "friendly" on the GLP-1 heuristic with the top score of 5: Saffron Road Butter Chicken (gluten-free claimed, contains milk) and Lean Cuisine Four Cheese Pizza (contains milk, soy, and wheat). This score is a transparent label based on the nutrition panel, not medical advice, and the Saffron Road protein and fiber values conflict between Kroger and FDC data (Kroger values used).

Gluten-free cereal a celiac can trust.summary: Only one cereal in the catalog cleared the checks for a celiac shopper: Kroger Crispy Rice Cereal, which declares wheat free and makes a gluten-free claim with no gluten ingredients listed. No product in the catalog carries a third-party gluten-free certification, so the claim rests on the retailer's own labeling. Check the package and your own celiac guidance before buying.
